schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Provides financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage due to unforeseen events like natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
benefits: Comprehensive risk coverage from pre-sowing to post-harvest
Low premium rates: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi crops
Quick claim settlement through remote sensing & technology
Coverage for prevented sowing due to adverse weather
schemes.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through nearest bank, insurance company office, or Common Service Centre (CSC). Also available on PMFBY mobile app.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (PM Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.description: Provides income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across India in three equal installments.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly to bank account
Paid in 3 installments of ₹2,000 each
No intermediaries — direct benefit transfer
Covers all farmer families with cultivable land
schemes.eligibility: All farmer families with cultivable landholding (subject to exclusion criteria).
schemes.how_to_apply: Register at pmkisan.gov.in or through local Patwari/Revenue Officer or Common Service Centre.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.description: Provides farmers with affordable and timely credit to meet their agricultural and allied needs including purchase of inputs.
benefits: Short-term credit for crop cultivation expenses
Post-harvest expenses covered
Maintenance and allied activities support
Interest subvention — 2% reduction on timely repayment
Accidental insurance coverage up to ₹50,000
schemes.eligibility: Farmers, self-help groups, and joint liability groups of farmers.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at any commercial bank, regional rural bank, or cooperative bank.

schemes.name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
schemes.description: Aims to increase production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals, and commercial crops through area expansion and productivity enhancement.
benefits: Free/subsidized distribution of quality seeds
Farm machinery subsidies
Demonstrations of improved varieties and technologies
Training programs for farmers
Subsidy on plant protection chemicals and micronutrients
schemes.eligibility: Farmers in notified districts across India.
schemes.how_to_apply: Contact local agriculture department office or block-level agriculture officer.

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
schemes.description: Promotes organic farming practices and helps farmers move towards sustainable and chemical-free agriculture.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000/ha over 3 years
₹31,000/ha for organic inputs from farm resources
₹8,800/ha for certification and quality control
₹4,000/ha for value addition and marketing
₹2,000/ha for awareness and capacity building
schemes.eligibility: Farmers willing to convert to organic farming in cluster groups (minimum 20 hectares).
schemes.how_to_apply: Contact nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or state agriculture department.

schemes.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
schemes.description: Promotes agricultural mechanization by providing subsidies on farm machinery and equipment to individual farmers and Custom Hiring Centres.
benefits: 40–50% subsidy on farm equipment for individual farmers
Up to 80% subsidy for SC/ST/small/marginal farmers
Financial assistance for Custom Hiring Centres
Subsidized tractors, power tillers, harvesters and more
schemes.eligibility: All categories of farmers with higher priority to SC/ST/small/marginal farmers.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through state agriculture department or at agrimachinery.nic.in portal.
